normal.name: cum (regular)
normal.text: Oh shit you are in for a treat. Years back I put together a chronological playlist of a few hundred DOS titles that I've been working through in order of release, so that I can play old games hitting them freshly within an old game mindset (I'm autistic). Loom is one that really stood out.
